intent: descriptive leave-one-component-out sensitivity of the frozen V2 model composite; not accuracy or target validation

method.baseline: equal-weight arithmetic mean of model-defined transport, building, and POI gaps; undefined components excluded
method.delta: signed leave-one-out score minus frozen V2 score; contribution metric is its absolute value
method.leave_one_out: omit one component and recompute the equal-weight mean over remaining components whose original frozen flags are defined

strata.unit: provided Census-derived urban/rural class label

methodology: docs/lanes/comp-zindi-bias-bounty.md (documented rural rule pct_urban < 0.5 used by earlier strata discoveries; bands here are analyst-chosen fixed edges, not organiser bins)
strata.unit: share of tract population in urban blocks (0-1, provided)

methodology: https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/urban-rural-continuum-codes/ (documented public code definitions for the 1-3 / 4-6 / 7-9 grouping)
strata.unit: provided USDA ERS Rural-Urban Continuum Code 2023
provided USDA ERS metro flag

methodology: https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/urban-rural-continuum-codes/ (NCHS classification documented as a provided urban/rural reference)
strata.unit: provided NCHS 2013 Urban/Rural Classification label
provided ACS tract total population

methodology: https://www2.census.gov/geo/pdfs/reference/GARM/Ch11GARM.pdf (ALAND is land area in square metres; density is population per km2)
strata.unit: provided population per square kilometre of ALAND
provided flag for any tribal land intersection
provided share of tract population on tribal land (0-1)
provided AIANNH legal/statistical kind
provided flag for statistical (non-legal) tribal area intersection

methodology: https://www.atsdr.cdc.gov/geographies-and-data/tsvi.html (CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index; bands here are analyst-chosen fixed edges on the provided 0-1 scale, not organiser bins)
strata.unit: provided SVI overall vulnerability percentile (0-1)
provided SVI minority/language theme percentile (0-1)
provided SVI housing/transport theme percentile (0-1)

methodology: https://www.atsdr.cdc.gov/cvi/ (CDC Climate Vulnerability Index; bands here are analyst-chosen fixed edges, not organiser bins)
strata.unit: provided CVI overall vulnerability score (0-1)
provided USDM summer percent of tract area at D2 or worse
provided mean PDSI/PMDI moisture anomaly

methodology: https://www.fs.usda.gov/research/geospatial/wildfirerisk/ (USFS Wildfire Risk to Public Lands exposure layers; the provided column name is treated as an ordinal hazard intensity)
strata.unit: provided USFS wildfire exposure probability for the highest flame-length class
provided MTBS mapped wildfire ever intersecting the tract
provided NIFC reported wildfire ever intersecting the tract
provided Fires On Demand human-caused ignition share
provided GEHE mean days above WBGT 30 C
provided CDC Heat Wave Days heat-stress mean index
provided Urban Heat Equities days per year above WBGTmax 28 C

methodology: https://carboneconomics.apache-subsite.website/ (CarbonPlan flood risk scoring context; provided column treated as an ordinal flood hazard)
strata.unit: provided CarbonPlan relative probability of flood score (2011 baseline)

method.undefined_leave_one_out: if no remaining components are defined, LOO score and delta are null, counted explicitly as undefined rather than imputed
